messages:
Aisha CSM: heads up — HelixCorp renewal is at signatures but finance flagged a mismatch on the PO vs billing entity. can we pause sending the final docs? :eyes:
Marco (Finance): noted. invoice entity is 'HelixCorp EU Ltd' but PO came back under 'HelixCorp US' — that triggers VAT/tax flow.
Priya (AM): client already showed DocuSign link to their procurement team. they want signers to be the US legal rep.
Aisha CSM: original contract executed by EU entity last year. procurement insists on using the US entity to speed payment. risk: we may mis-route invoices and delay revenue recognition.
Eli (Legal): dont sign anything that changes contracting entity without legal/ops approval. can you paste the PO and the proposed signer details?
Aisha CSM: PO snippet:
```
PO#: HC-2026-4590
BillTo: HelixCorp US, TaxID: 12-3456789
ContractEntity: HelixCorp EU Ltd, VAT: GB123456789
```
Link to DocuSign: https://docusign.example/abcdef
Priya (AM): procurement attached a short note: "please sign with US entity to avoid intercompany routing". they also asked if we can do net45 instead of net30.
Marco (Finance): net45 requires approval for this ARR. plus entity mismatch requires AP to confirm vendor code. I can escalate but need PO, vendor code, and tax docs.
Eli (Legal): workflow: (1) stop signature, (2) request confirmation from customer on entity change, (3) finance validates tax implications, (4) legal updates contract amendment if entity switch confirmed.
DocuSign-bot: Document "HelixCorp-Renewal-2026" viewed by HelixProcurement@helixcorp.com (3 views). Status: envelope sent.
Aisha CSM: action items — @Marco can you try to get vendor code and confirm whether AP will accept the US entity? @Priya pls ping the procurement contact and ask them to confirm on their letterhead if they need the US entity and authorize net45. I'll hold the sign button.
Marco (Finance): will do. pinging AP now. if they accept US vendor code, billing will create a new invoice entity mapping; otherwise finance will refuse until corrected. ETA 24h.
Priya (AM): i'm on the call with procurement in 15m, will get confirmation and capture who the authorized signer will be.
Eli (Legal): if they confirm US entity, i'll prepare a one-line amendment that swaps contracting entity and preserves terms. should be quick.
Aisha CSM: thanks team — keep updates here. if we get the confirmation, i'll re-open the DocuSign envelope and tag the right signer. :thumbsup:
Priya (AM): update — procurement confirmed they need US entity and provided vendor code VC-HELI-US. they forwarded a signed memo. attaching in thread (sent to you via DM).
Marco (Finance): got the memo. AP confirmed they can accept VC-HELI-US but will need a copy of the amendment and the US tax form. i'll prepare invoice flow once we have amendment.
Eli (Legal): ok i'll draft the amendment now and send to Aisha for quick review before re-send.
Aisha CSM: perfect. re-open when amendment attached. priority is to avoid mis-billing and hold revenue until records match. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
